description: This file manages the Redux state slice for 'boards' in a web application, including actions, reducers, selectors, and async thunks for handling board data, members, templates, and user memberships.

methods.name: fetchBoardMembers
methods.description: Async thunk to fetch members of a specific board and update the store with user data.

methods.name: updateMembersEnsuringBoardsAndUsers
methods.description: Async thunk to update board members, ensuring related boards and user data are loaded.

methods.name: updateMembersHandler
methods.description: Reducer handler to update the state with new board members.

methods.name: getBoard
methods.description: Selector function to retrieve a specific board or template by ID.

methods.name: getMySortedBoards
methods.description: Selector to get user's boards sorted by title.

methods.name: getSortedTemplates
methods.description: Selector to get templates sorted by title.

methods.name: getCurrentBoard
methods.description: Selector to get the current selected board or template.

methods.name: getCurrentBoardMembers
methods.description: Selector to get members of the current board.

methods.name: getMyBoardMembership
methods.description: Selector to get the user's membership info for a specific board.
